title: SLO drift breadcrumbs and alerting journey prototype
creator: Asha Mehta
description: Problem: On-call engineers and platform PMs lose quick situational awareness when SLOs start to drift. Existing graphs live in SLO pages but require context-switching to create or tune alerts, and runbook links are buried behind menus. Goal: Design a compact, contextual surface within the Console that surfaces recent SLO drift as a horizontal breadcrumb timeline, provides one-click suggestions for alert creation, and exposes incident/postmortem anchors to shorten handoffs.
acceptance_criteria: SLO breadcrumb bar is visible on SLO overview and relevant route dashboards and shows up to 7 drift points with timestamp and delta
Clicking a breadcrumb opens a Quick-Alert modal prefilled with suggested threshold, lookback window, and recommended runbook links
Quick-Alert modal allows creating alert or saving as draft and links to rollout/canary options in Console
Event Ink markers in token-level traces link directly to incidents and postmortem documents (if available) within 2 clicks
Design validated in at least 6 moderated usability sessions with on-call engineers and achieve task success >= 85% for creating a tuned alert from drift
decisions: We will surface the breadcrumb in two places: SLO overview and per-route dashboard. Suggested thresholds use adaptive heuristic (baseline: 3x p95 delta or absolute 5% SLO drop) rather than fixed templates. Quick-Alert creates an 'ephemeral suggestion' that must be confirmed by project owners. We deferred automatic runbook-writing to a follow-up because content quality and ownership vary across customers.

notes_for_engineering: Breadcrumb payload will return an ordered list of {timestamp, slo_value, delta_pct, incident_id?} (we're using a minimal schema to keep perf impact low). Quick-Alert endpoints should accept proposed_threshold, lookback_window, and metadata tags. UX expects latency < 200ms for breadcrumb render on SLO overview; if not feasible, fall back to progressive loading with skeletons.
usability_plan: Recruit: 6 on-call engineers (mix of customer-facing ops and infra SREs). Tasks: 1) identify cause of SLO drop using breadcrumb; 2) create and tune an alert; 3) link alert to runbook and create handoff note. Metrics: task success, time-on-task, SUS, qualitative quotes. Prototype test script in Drive link above.
risk_and_mitigation: Risk: Over-surface alerts leading to alert fatigue. Mitigation: default to suggestions saved as drafts, show estimated cost delta, require confirm by project owner. Risk: data lag causing stale breadcrumbs. Mitigation: cap 'recent' breadcrumb to 24h and show 'last refreshed' timestamp and progressive data placeholder.
